words.gloss: he of the land (part of split phrase)
to those who (part of split phrase)

literal: Promptness, learning, and possession of courage—these three should never depart from those who rule the land.
translation: Promptness in action, learning, and decisiveness—these three qualities must never depart from those who rule the land.
modern: சுறுசுறுப்பு, கல்வி, துணிவு ஆகிய இந்த மூன்றும் நாட்டை ஆளுபவர்களிடமிருந்து நீங்காமல் இருக்க வேண்டும்.
explanation: This couplet outlines the three indispensable qualities of a successful ruler. 'தூங்காமை' literally means 'non-sleeping' or 'not delaying', representing promptness and the avoidance of sloth. 'கல்வி' denotes the acquisition of knowledge and wisdom, while 'துணிவுடைமை' is the possession of courage and decisiveness in taking action. The poet emphasizes that these three traits must never depart ('நீங்கா') from those who govern the earth ('நிலன் ஆள்பவர்க்கு', split metrically here as 'நிலனான் பவர்க்கு').
